description: out = decay * s + dtx * b, where decay and dtx hold one value per row of s and b holds one value per column of s. decay and dtx are [64, 32] and only their column 0 is read (the value of row r is decay[r, 0] and dtx[r, 0]); b is [32, 128] and only its row 0 is read (the value of column j is b[0, j]). The other entries are not meant to be used. This is the Mamba-2 state update with the per-head scalars and B kept in their compact form
